title: Long-read transcriptome analysis using IsoRanker for identifying pathogenic variants in Mendelian conditions.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the Data and code availability statement in the PMC XML (NCBI efetch): sequencing data are deposited in NHGRI AnVIL (Analysis Visualization and Informatics Lab-space) under dbGaP accession phs003047, a controlled-access study; only code is public (github.com/yhhc2/IsoRanker). Europe PMC supplement endpoint returned no zip; Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cohort of 31 individuals (3 with known transcript-altering variants, 28 unsolved), paired cycloheximide-treated/untreated fibroblast long-read transcriptomes, 4 new leads and HARS1 case — all from abstract/text, not files.

a1_downloadable.note: Data in AnVIL under dbGaP phs003047 (controlled access, needs a data access application); patient data from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Checked in the availability statement, not attempted.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label table; 'pathogenic transcript alteration' exists for only 3 known positive individuals plus a few new leads, so a label would have to be constructed. From paper text only.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are raw long-read sequencing behind controlled access; no processed public feature table found.

a5_enough_rows.note: Unit is the individual: 31 people, about 3 known positives (paper text). Far below 400.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; raw long-read transcriptomes and genomes, likely hundreds of GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Not checked; raw sequencing would need re-processing.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check, no files accessible.

a8_label_provenance.note: Known diagnoses come from clinical genetic work-up, not a model, per paper text.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: with 31 individuals and ~3 known positives, no model claim could be made beyond case reports.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use long-read RNA isoform measurements from patient skin cells to predict which rare non-coding variants disrupt gene transcripts.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-gene and per-isoform expression, allelic imbalance and nonsense-mediated decay signals from 31 individuals' fibroblasts; number of labelled examples unknown, about 3 known positive cases.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene carries a disease-causing transcript alteration, with truth from clinical diagnosis of the individual.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Rare-disease diagnostic labs would gain functional evidence for unclassified splice and non-coding variants.

ml_idea: Outlier-isoform classifier for rare-disease variant prioritisation; infeasible because data are controlled-access and there are ~31 individuals.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; data inaccessible without a dbGaP application.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement: dbGaP phs003047 controlled access — already kills it.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: sequencing data are controlled access (dbGaP/AnVIL phs003047) needing an application; also A5 fails, with only 31 individuals and about 3 known positive cases.
